scenarios.name: Rate limited
scenarios.note: fake-upstream answers 429 once. The response comes back as it was, and Postern's rate-limit headers say none are left.

scenarios.name: Server error
scenarios.note: fake-upstream answers 500 once. The service failed, not Postern, and the response has to make that clear.

scenarios.name: Hang
scenarios.note: fake-upstream holds one Octopus request for 20 s. Sallyport gives up after 4 s, and another app's request has to get through meanwhile.

scenarios.name: Dropped connection
scenarios.note: fake-upstream closes the connection without answering. Postern turns that into its own error rather than hanging or passing on garbage.
